## FT Music for Android

Download the attached `FT-Music-v*.apk` on an Android 8.0+ device. To update an existing installation signed with the same FT Music key, install the new APK over it; do not uninstall first if you want to retain app data. Android will ask for confirmation and check the signature. In the app, use **Library → Check for updates** for future GitHub releases.

Home now has a dark, RamBox-inspired layout with listening history, anonymous discovery, browseable albums/playlists and mood search. The bundled demo tracks are no longer featured on Home; they remain under Library → Samples to preserve existing libraries. New installs start with an empty queue.

This is an early prototype, not a full Prism or RamBox replacement. An Android emulator smoke test passed for the redesigned screens and a bundled sample, but physical-device installation, LRCLIB and downloads have not been verified. A live network check returned YouTube discovery and search results but required sign-in or bot verification for the tested streams; playback may fail and can be opened in YouTube Music instead. YouTube discovery, browsing, search, playback and downloads use unofficial interfaces, can fail or change, and may be subject to YouTube's terms. Download only content you have permission to save. Optional FT Music account sync requires a separate private HTTPS server; it does not sync a YouTube account. Android Auto integration is not included.
